friends.doc: The friends list and its Inbox (Docs/features/15-social.md §2.1, §2.3).

max.doc: How many friends a player may have.

maxSent.doc: How many friend requests a player may have waiting for an answer at once.

requestRows.doc: Rows the requests list fills with suggestions, counting the requests already in it.

requestHours.doc: Hours a friend request waits for an answer before it expires.

messageDays.doc: Days an Inbox message is kept.
